neer_yoy.label: NEER YoY
neer_yoy.method_note: Nominal effective exchange rate YoY, broad basket. Calculated from latest monthly BIS index vs same month previous year. Positive = appreciation.

reer_yoy.label: REER YoY
reer_yoy.method_note: Real effective exchange rate YoY, broad basket. Calculated from latest monthly BIS index vs same month previous year. Positive = appreciation.

current_acct.label: Current Acct.
current_acct.source: IMF DataMapper — World Economic Outlook April 2026
current_acct.method_note: Current account balance, percent of GDP. Current/latest column uses 2026 WEO projection where available.

trade_balance.label: Trade Balance
trade_balance.source: World Bank WDI — External balance on goods and services (% of GDP)
trade_balance.method_note: External balance on goods and services, percent of GDP. Exports minus imports of goods and services, not goods-only merchandise balance.

net_pri_income.label: Net Pri. Income
net_pri_income.source: World Bank WDI — Net primary income (BoP, current US$)
net_pri_income.method_note: Net primary income from BoP current US$, divided by GDP current US$ to express as %GDP. Latest annual observation available.

fin_account.label: Fin. Account
fin_account.source: World Bank WDI — Net financial account (BoP, current US$)
fin_account.method_note: Net financial account from BoP current US$, divided by GDP current US$ to express as %GDP. Sign follows World Bank/IMF BoP convention. Latest annual observation available.

fdi_net.label: FDI net
fdi_net.source: BPM6 net direct investment (assets minus liabilities). IMF ESR; BOP IFS.

portfolio_net.label: Portfolio net
portfolio_net.source: CA minus TB minus Net Current Transfers (WEO/BOP data).

other_invest.label: Other Invest.
other_invest.source: IMF ESR July 2025; BIS IBS for cross-border banking flows.

net_cap_flows.label: Net Cap Flows
net_cap_flows.source: CA minus TB minus Net Current Transfers (WEO/BOP data).

gfcf.label: GFCF
gfcf.source: World Bank WDI — Gross fixed capital formation (% of GDP)
gfcf.method_note: Gross fixed capital formation, percent of GDP. Current/latest column uses latest available World Bank observation by country.

gdp_pc.label: GDP p.c.
gdp_pc.source: IMF DataMapper — World Economic Outlook April 2026
gdp_pc.method_note: GDP per capita, current prices, U.S. dollars per capita. Current/latest column uses 2026 WEO projection where available.

gdp_growth.label: GDP Growth
gdp_growth.source: IMF DataMapper — World Economic Outlook April 2026
gdp_growth.method_note: Real GDP growth, annual percent change. Current/latest column uses 2026 WEO projection where available.

labor_prod.label: Labor Prod.
labor_prod.source: OECD Productivity Statistics (through 2023 for OECD members, 2024 preliminary). ILO for non-OECD.

tfp_growth.label: TFP Growth
tfp_growth.source: Our World in Data / Penn World Table 11.0
tfp_growth.method_note: Calculated from PWT/OWID TFP level as 100 * (TFP_t / TFP_{t-1} - 1).

inflation_cpi.label: CPI inflation, latest YoY
inflation_cpi.source: Trading Economics — Inflation Rate country list
inflation_cpi.method_note: Latest headline CPI inflation, year-over-year. Not IMF WEO annual average.

policy_rate.label: Policy rate, latest
policy_rate.source: Trading Economics — Interest Rate country list
policy_rate.method_note: Latest available policy rate from Trading Economics. Not a 2025 forecast.

fiscal_balance.label: Fiscal Balance
fiscal_balance.source: IMF Fiscal Monitor April 2026 (general government overall balance % GDP).

govt_gross_debt.label: Govt Gross Debt
govt_gross_debt.source: IMF DataMapper — World Economic Outlook April 2026
govt_gross_debt.method_note: Current/latest column uses 2026 WEO projection where available; otherwise latest available WEO year.

credit_privsect.label: Credit/Priv.Sect.
credit_privsect.source: Not yet published by BIS/World Bank for most countries; column left as n/a.

niip.label: NIIP
niip.source: IMF IIP statistics / IMF External Sector Report
niip.method_note: NIIP values are expressed as % of GDP. 2024 is treated as the observed benchmark. 2025e is retained as an estimate and explicitly flagged; it should not be read as observed IIP data.

gross_ext_assets.label: Gross Ext. Assets
gross_ext_assets.source: IMF IIP; 2025e estimated. Note: large swings due to valuation effects from currency moves.

gross_ext_liab.label: Gross Ext. Liab.
gross_ext_liab.source: IMF IIP; 2025e estimated. Note: large swings due to valuation effects from currency moves.

ext_debt_total.label: Ext. Debt Total
ext_debt_total.method_note: Reset to original dashboard Ext. Debt (total) values. Values are expressed as %GDP. 2024 is treated as baseline/actual table value; 2025e is treated as estimated table value.

st_ext_debt.label: ST Ext. Debt
st_ext_debt.source: IMF Fiscal Monitor April 2026 (Table A1 AEs; Table C EMs).

int_reserves.label: Int. Reserves
int_reserves.source: IMF COFER/IFS. End-2024 actuals; end-2025 estimates. USD billions and % of GDP.

st_debt_reserves.label: ST Debt/Reserves
st_debt_reserves.source: Short-term external debt ÷ international reserves × 100. Threshold: <100% = adequate; >150% = elevated vulnerability.

terms_of_trade.label: Terms of Trade
terms_of_trade.source: IMF WEO Apr 2026 (commodity-linked), index ~2016=100. Large oil exporters (Russia, Saudi Arabia) show meaningful ToT variation.

wb_rule_of_law.label: WB Rule of Law
wb_rule_of_law.source: WGI RL.EST: confidence in rules, contract enforcement, property rights, police, courts.

wb_govt_effectiveness.label: WB Govt Effectiveness
wb_govt_effectiveness.source: WGI GE.EST: quality of public services, bureaucracy, policy credibility.

wb_regulatory_quality.label: WB Regulatory Quality
wb_regulatory_quality.source: WGI RQ.EST: ability to formulate sound policies for private sector development.

wb_control_of_corruption.label: WB Control of Corruption
wb_control_of_corruption.source: WGI CC.EST: public power not used for private gain.

capital_controls.label: Capital Controls
capital_controls.source: IMF AREAER 2024 (Annual Report on Exchange Arrangements and Exchange Restrictions). Rating scale: None / Low / Moderate / Significant / Extensive.

labor_market.label: Labor Market
labor_market.source: OECD Employment Protection Legislation (EPL) database 2023; ILO ILOSTAT; national labor codes. Covers: dismissal rules, collective bargaining, social contributions, informality.

industrial_policy.label: Industrial Policy
industrial_policy.source: OECD PMR (Product Market Regulation) 2023; UNCTAD IIA Monitor; national investment laws. Covers: subsidies, SOEs, local content, barriers to entry.

trade_barriers.label: Trade Barriers
trade_barriers.source: WTO Trade Policy Reviews 2022-2025; WTO tariff profiles 2024; OECD STRI 2023. Average MFN tariff from WTO Tariff Download Facility. Covers: tariffs, NTBs, import licensing, standards.

credit_private_sector.label: Credit/Priv.Sect.
credit_private_sector.source: World Bank WDI FS.AST.PRVT.GD.ZS; BIS/FRED total credit to private non-financial sector where WDI is stale or unavailable
credit_private_sector.method_note: Private-sector credit as % of GDP. Uses World Bank WDI domestic credit to private sector where recent; uses BIS/FRED total credit to private non-financial sector for Canada and Saudi Arabia because WDI latest observations were stale.

labor_productivity.label: Labor Prod. Growth
labor_productivity.source: Our World in Data / Penn World Table 11.0
labor_productivity.method_note: Calculated from PWT/OWID labor productivity level as 100 * (LaborProd_t / LaborProd_t-1 - 1).

private_consumption.label: Priv. Consumption
private_consumption.source: World Bank WDI — Households and NPISHs final consumption expenditure (% of GDP)
private_consumption.method_note: Households and NPISHs final consumption expenditure, percent of GDP. Current/latest column uses latest available World Bank observation by country.

reserves_gdp.label: Int. Reserves
reserves_gdp.source: World Bank WDI — Total reserves incl. gold (current US$)
reserves_gdp.method_note: Total reserves including gold, current US$, divided by GDP current US$ to express as %GDP. Latest annual observation with GDP denominator.
